cases.sentence: Благодарите ___, потому что Он благ и милость Его навеки.
cases.explain: The verb благодарите (give thanks) is transitive and takes the accusative case; for animate nouns, accusative looks like genitive.

cases.sentence: Призвал я в беде имя Господне, и Он ответил ___, и на пространное место поставил меня.
cases.explain: The verb ответил (answered) with the preposition 'to me' takes the dative case; мне is the dative form.

cases.sentence: Господь со мной, мне нечего бояться. Что может сделать мне ___?
cases.explain: The verb сделать (do/make) is transitive and takes the accusative case; человека is the accusative of человек.

cases.sentence: Лучше искать у Господа прибежище, чем надеяться на ___.
cases.explain: The verb надеяться with preposition на (on/upon) takes the accusative case; на человека means 'on man.'

cases.sentence: Они окружили, обступили меня со всех ___, но во имя Господня я уничтожил их.
cases.explain: The phrase со всех сторон (from all sides) requires the genitive case after the preposition со.

cases.sentence: Господь — ___ моя и песнь, Он стал моим спасением.
cases.explain: The noun сила (strength) is a predicate nominative after the linking verb быть, describing the subject.

cases.sentence: Голос радости и спасения в жилищах ___.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition в (in) to express location; в жилищах праведников means 'in the dwellings of the righteous.'

cases.sentence: Вяжите веревками ___ жертву, ведите к рогам жертвенника.
cases.explain: The adjective праздничную (festival) modifies the accusative noun жертву (sacrifice), taking the accusative form.

reading.ru: Благодарите Господа, потому что Он благ и милость Его навеки.
reading.question: Why should we give thanks to the Lord?
options: Because He is good and His mercy endures forever
Because He has made us wealthy and powerful
Because He has given us dominion over all creation
Because He has promised us ease and comfort
reading.correct: Because He is good and His mercy endures forever
reading.explain: The text gives two reasons: God is good 'Он благ' and His mercy is eternal 'милость Его навеки.'

reading.ru: Призвал я в беде имя Господне, и Он ответил мне, и на пространное место поставил меня.
reading.question: How did the Lord respond to the psalmist's cry in distress?
options: He answered him and set him in a spacious place
He sent angels to protect him
He revealed His glory to him
reading.correct: He answered him and set him in a spacious place
reading.explain: The text states 'Он ответил мне, и на пространное место поставил меня' (He answered me and set me in a spacious place).

reading.ru: Лучше искать у Господа прибежище, чем надеяться на человека. Лучше искать у Господа прибежище, чем надеяться на правителей.
reading.question: What does this passage teach us?
options: Trusting in the Lord is better than trusting in man or rulers
We should avoid all human assistance
Rulers are always evil and untrustworthy
reading.correct: Trusting in the Lord is better than trusting in man or rulers
reading.explain: The text contrasts seeking refuge in the Lord with trusting in man or rulers, showing the superiority of divine trust.

reading.ru: Сильно толкнули меня, чтобы я упал, но Господь поддержал меня.
reading.question: What adversity did the psalmist face, and how was he protected?
options: He was pushed hard to fall, but the Lord sustained him
He was trapped in prison but escaped
He was pursued by enemies but hid safely
He was wounded but healed by God
reading.correct: He was pushed hard to fall, but the Lord sustained him
reading.explain: The text says 'Сильно толкнули меня, чтобы я упал, но Господь поддержал меня' (They pushed me hard to make me fall, but the Lord upheld me).

reading.ru: Это ворота Господни, в которые войдут праведные. Славлю тебя, потому что ты услышал меня и стал моим спасением.
reading.question: What is the psalmist grateful for?
options: That God heard him and became his salvation
That God has given him a great kingdom
That God has made him rich and famous
That God has promised him a long life
reading.correct: That God heard him and became his salvation
reading.explain: The text says 'Славлю тебя, потому что ты услышал меня и стал моим спасением' (I praise you because you heard me and became my salvation).

reading.ru: Камень, который отвергли строители, стал краеугольным. Это совершил Господь. И как это удивительно в глазах наших.
reading.question: What is the significance of the rejected stone in this verse?
options: The stone that builders rejected became the cornerstone—something marvelous God has done
Builders made a mistake in choosing stones
A valuable stone was found among the ruins
The temple was rebuilt with rejected stones
reading.correct: The stone that builders rejected became the cornerstone—something marvelous God has done
reading.explain: The text uses the metaphor of a stone rejected by builders that becomes the cornerstone, emphasizing God's work and its wonderfulness.
